block.guhs.among_taakpaneel.lore: Task 1 of 1: do nothing. Done, Nyeg!
block.guhs.among_noodknop.lore: Only press in an emergency. Or when bored.
gui.guhs.among.rol.crew.onder: Do your tasks and find the Mika
gui.guhs.among.rol.mika.onder: Push everybody asleep. Don't get seen, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.begin.crew: You are %1$s of the crew of The Chonkfarer. Mikas on board: %2$s. Do your tasks at the panels (they are listed at the top left), right-click a sleeper to report it and press the emergency button in the Cafeteria when you see something odd.
gui.guhs.among.begin.mika: You are %1$s and secretly a Mika (Mikas on board: %2$s). Pillow: push a guh asleep when nobody is looking. Sabotage Map: lights out, Nibble Alarm or doors shut. Right-click a vent to crawl away. And pretend to do tasks!
gui.guhs.among.begin.maat: Your fellow Mika is %s. No pushing each other, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.geduwd.onder: %s pushed you asleep. You simply dream on.
gui.guhs.among.droomguh: You are a dream guh now: you float, go through walls and nobody sees you. Your tasks still count, so finish them! Only other dream guhs hear what you say.
gui.guhs.among.gemeld: %1$s found %2$s asleep! Meeting in the Cafeteria.
gui.guhs.among.knop: %s pressed the emergency button! Meeting in the Cafeteria.
gui.guhs.among.stemmen: Time to vote: pick a guh or skip.
gui.guhs.among.uitslag.gelijk: A tie: nobody was voted out.
gui.guhs.among.uitslag.mika: %1$s flies to the Dorm with a pillow. %1$s was the Mika!
gui.guhs.among.uitslag.geen_mika: %1$s flies to the Dorm with a pillow. %1$s was not the Mika...
gui.guhs.among.weggestemd.jij: You were voted out and are now snug in the Dorm. As a dream guh you can still finish your tasks.
gui.guhs.among.sabotage.alarm.onder: Type the code at the Reactor and in Navigation, within 45 seconds
gui.guhs.among.sabotage.alarm.half: %1$s typed the code (%2$s). One more panel!
gui.guhs.among.sabotage.alarm.klaar: The Nibble Alarm is off: %s typed the last code.
gui.guhs.among.sabotage.deuren: The doors of %s are shut for a moment!
gui.guhs.among.taak.stap: Step done: on to the next panel
gui.guhs.among.einde.mikas_weg: No Mika is awake any more.
gui.guhs.among.einde.overmacht: Too few guhs are still awake.
gui.guhs.among.einde.alarm: The Nibble Alarm ran out: all the nibbles are gone.
gui.guhs.among.einde.gewonnen: You won! That is %1$s more coins (you can still earn %2$s today).
gui.guhs.among.einde.verloren: You lost, but it was cozy all the same. That is %1$s more coins (you can still earn %2$s today).
gui.guhs.among.nee.te_ver: You are too far away for that
gui.guhs.among.nee.mag_niet: You may not do that, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.nee.knop_op: You already used your emergency button
gui.guhs.among.nee.knop_alarm: Turn off the Nibble Alarm first!
gui.guhs.among.nee.luik: Only a Mika fits through there, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.nee.geen_taak: You have nothing to do here right now
gui.guhs.among.nee.taak_mislukt: That was too quick: try again
gui.guhs.among.nee.geen_vergadering: There is no meeting now. Your tasks are at the top left
gui.guhs.among.thuis.taakpaneel: Task 1 of 1: do nothing. Done, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.among.thuis.noodknop: Emergency meeting! ...nobody comes, everybody is asleep
gui.guhs.among.thuis.ventilatieluik: You don't fit through there. Too many nibbles, Nyeg
gui.guhs.among.thuis.spelitem: This only works on board The Chonkfarer
gui.guhs.among.wachtrij.regels.lastig: Hard: 10 participants, 2 Mikas, one and a half times the coins
gui.guhs.among.wachtrij.eerst_oefenen: Play the practice round at Captain Guh first
gui.guhs.among.wachtrij.eruit: You walked out of the queue
gui.guhs.among.vergadering.droomguh: You are dreaming: you only watch.
gui.guhs.among.vergadering.straks: You may vote in a moment.
quest.guhs.among.kapitein.hallo: Welcome aboard The Chonkfarer, Nyeg! Somewhere among the crew is a Mika who pushes everybody asleep. Do you dare to come along?
quest.guhs.among.kapitein.uitleg: Crew: do your tasks at the panels, report sleepers and vote the Mika out. Mika: push everybody asleep without anybody seeing it. Nobody gets hurt: whoever sleeps dreams on as a dream guh. Winning gives %1$s coins, losing %2$s, and every own task %3$s. At most %4$s coins a day.
quest.guhs.among.kapitein.eerst_oefenen: The practice round first, Nyeg. After that you may try it for real.
quest.guhs.among.logboek.cijfers: Your logbook: %1$s rounds played. Won as crew: %2$s. Won as Mika: %3$s. Wrongly voted out: %4$s times (poor thing, Nyeg). Tasks done: %5$s. Earned today: %6$s of the %7$s coins.
gui.guhs.among.gids.uitleg: The real game at Captain Guh: do tasks, report sleepers and vote the Mika out. Or be the Mika yourself, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.among_sus: Get voted out three times in Among Guhs
gui.guhs.titels.hint.among_onterecht: Get voted out while you were not the Mika
gui.guhs.titels.hint.among_kussenkampioe: Win five rounds of Among Guhs as the Mika
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_ronde.title: Aboard The Chonkfarer
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_ronde.desc: Talk to &bCaptain Guh&r in the Guhpixel lobby and play a whole round of &dAmong Guhs&r. Crew: do your tasks and vote the Mika out. Mika: push everybody asleep without anybody seeing it. Empty places are filled with guhs in space suits. Nobody gets hurt: whoever sleeps simply dreams on.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_crew_winst.des: Win a round as &bcrew&r: finish all tasks together, or vote the Mika out in a meeting. Listen well to what the guhs say: they tell what they really saw. Mostly, Nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_mika_winst.des: Win a round as the &cMika&r. Only push when nobody is looking, crawl through the vents, put the lights out and say in the meeting with a straight snout that you were in the Cafeteria.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_lastig.title: Two Mikas on Board
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.among_lastig.desc: Play a round on &6Hard&r: ten participants, two Mikas and one and a half times the coins. The leader of the queue picks the level.
gui.guhs.among.taak.worstjes.bezig: The sausages are being tied together. Red to red, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.taak.pasje.bezig: The card goes through the reader. Not too fast, not too slow.
gui.guhs.among.taak.kruimelbak.bezig: The lever is down. All the crumbs fly out into space.
gui.guhs.among.taak.pindasaus.bezig: The peanut sauce sloshes into the tank. No tasting!
gui.guhs.among.taak.sorteren.bezig: Cheese nibbles left, plain nibbles right, crumbs in your snout.
gui.guhs.among.taak.dromen.bezig: The dreams are coming in. This may take a while, Nyeg...
gui.guhs.among.taak.wegen.bezig: Stand still on the scale... Result: chonk.
gui.guhs.among.taak.schakelaars.bezig: Click, clack, click. All switches up.
gui.guhs.among.taak.herstel_licht.bezig: The switches go back on, one by one.
gui.guhs.among.taak.herstel_alarm.bezig: The code: n-i-b-b-l-e. Don't tell anyone.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.gevonden.1: %1$s is snoozing in %2$s. That didn't happen by itself, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.knop.0: I pressed the button. Something is off on this ship.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.knop.1: Emergency meeting! I saw something odd.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.knop.2: Sorry to disturb, but this had to happen, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.waar_ik.1: I was just in %2$s doing my task.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.gezien.1: %1$s was walking around in %2$s just now.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.bij_slaper.0: I saw %1$s right beside the sleeper in %2$s!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.bij_slaper.1: %1$s was standing right next to it in %2$s. Sus, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.bij_slaper.2: When I came into %2$s, %1$s was just walking away.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.luik.0: I saw %1$s come out of the vent!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.luik.1: %1$s crawled through the vents. Only a Mika does that!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.luik.2: The vent opened and there was %1$s. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.duw.1: %1$s did it! With a pillow! I saw it myself!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.duw.2: %1$s is the Mika. I was right there, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.verdenk.1: %1$s is sus, if you ask me.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.sta_in.0: I vouch for %1$s, who was with me.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.sta_in.1: %1$s was with me the whole time. Sweet little chonk.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.sta_in.2: It can't be %1$s: we were together.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.klopt_niet.0: That's not right: I saw %1$s in %2$s just now.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.klopt_niet.1: %1$s wasn't there at all. I saw you in %2$s!
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.klopt_niet.2: %1$s is fibbing. They were in %2$s, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.niks.1: I was nearly asleep. What happened?
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.niks.2: No idea. I was thinking about nibbles.
gui.guhs.among.uitspraak.sus.1: I'll just say it: it's always %1$s.
